facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/banmo.py.create_banmo_model: create a BanMo neural scene graph model with NeRF shape, appearance, and motion modules for non-rigid 3D reconstruction

facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/cse.py.create_CSENet_human: create a CSENet instance with ishuman=True to load the SMPL human mesh model for dense pose estimation
facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/cse.py.create_CSENet_animal: create a CSENet instance with ishuman=False to load the sheep animal mesh model for dense pose estimation

facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/geom_util.build_skinning_weights: build a skinning weight matrix from bone ellipsoids and 3D points using gaussian mahalanobis distance
facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/geom_util.create_rigid_transform_invert: create a function that inverts rigid transformation matrices with rotation and translation components

facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/geom_util.compute_flow_matching: compute optical flow between two frames using CSE feature matching or geodesic distance matching

facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/loss_util.compute_eikonal_loss: compute the eikonal loss for backward warped points using an MLP and positional embedding
facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/loss_util.compute_visibility_loss: compute visibility loss from positive and negative samples using an MLP and positional embedding
facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/loss_util.compute_feat_match_loss: compute feature matching loss between NeRF features and 3D points using expected point regression
facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/loss_util.compute_rtk_loss: compute rotation and translation loss between predicted and ground truth rigid transformation matrices
facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/loss_util.compute_shape_init_loss: compute signed distance function loss between an MLP and a mesh using sampled points

facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/nerf.py.build_NeRF_model: build a NeRF model with configurable depth, hidden units, skip connections, and input channels for neural radiance fields
facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/nerf.py.create_Embedding_module: create a Fourier feature embedding module that maps inputs to sin and cos frequency bands with cosine windowing

facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/nerf.py.build_FrameCode_module: build a FrameCode module that converts frame and video indices into embedding codes using Fourier features and MLP

facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/rendering.render_rays_nerf: render rays through NeRF models to produce RGB and depth maps with coarse and fine sampling

facebookresearch_banmo/nnutils/rendering.inference_deform_skinning: run inference with deformation support using flow-based or bone-based skinning for animated NeRF rendering
